comparison.objective: Clamp a glue joint with parallel handscrew jaws, versus commission a robot-axis shock absorber.
comparison.physical_skill: Coordinate two screw handles to control jaw parallelism and clamp force versus use a hex key and collar, then tune from repeated impacts.
comparison.success_condition: Boards remain clamped with jaws bearing flat versus two non-bottoming, non-rebounding stops followed by a lock-drift witness test.
comparison.reason: Both involve bimanual stabilization and rotary adjustment, but they test different coupled mechanics: parallel clamping versus iterative damping and retained calibration. No spec versions are present; the body gives no numeric flatness or holding-force rubric.
